name: amber-crt
description: Amber phosphor CRT look: warm amber text on near-black. All fg/cursor/accent pairs >= 4.5:1 (AA) on bg; most AAA.
_notes: Keys match pi/terminal/theme.py terminal.theme schema. ANSI index 0 (black) raised to #8a7a55 so even the dimmest slot clears AA. fg #ffb347, bg #0a0a06.
